name: Tyrania Enforcers
source:
In a world on the brink of conflict, Linda, a questionable journalist, is assigned to follow the journey of a group of enforcers, soldiers responsible for upholding the absolute rules of imperial Justice across the vast Tyranian Empire.

As her journey unfolds, she witnesses what it takes to maintain local order and the cost of security. With crime and terrorism becoming ever more pervasive, Linda is forced to question her old beliefs as her once-naive view of the world slowly begins to shatter. 

Beyond the illusion of peace, war is brewing between the Empire and the Union, tensions rise between criminals and the authorities, and her relationship with Emie, a Corporal in the service of the Empire, is pushed to its limit. 

There is no such thing as peace as long as there are criminals!

For Retribution,

Seek Justice!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4336290/]Steam[/url]]
